notes: Fixture: evals/fixtures/discount-module — a tiny node project (src/, test/, docs/) with a full review target under reviews/discount-module/: review-v1.md (immutable), ledger.md with a fix brief and a trigger classification per finding, resolution-v1.md scaffolded with every row `open`, metrics.jsonl, and reviews/state/. Two seeded blockers in two different files, so no protocol cluster is owed; PPW-9702 is trigger-list-shaped with no pre-check verdict, so an approach-check must run and be stamped. A fix round commits, so the round may not run in the checked-in fixture: `setup` builds a throwaway git repository at evals/.run/discount-module (git-ignored) whose first commit holds the whole fixture, and prints RUN_ROOT and BASE_COMMIT for the grader to diff against. Every review-system script takes --root <run root>. run-scoped-tests.mjs parses dotnet and vitest summary lines and falls back to `node --test`'s TAP totals, so the fixture's suite stamps its real passed/failed counts. The records name no real commit sha (`commit: fixture-base`) because the throwaway repository has no pushed ref for the auditor to resolve one against.

status.trigger-eval: trigger-eval.json is a description test, not a fixture test: it survives unchanged apart from two rows added 2026-09-01 — one unattended fix round (trigger) and one loop-driver phrase (must not trigger).

evals.prompt: Address the open findings in the code review for the discount module — the review is under reviews/discount-module/. The module and its review live in a throwaway git repository at .claude/skills/fix-review/evals/.run/discount-module: work and commit there, and pass --root ".claude/skills/fix-review/evals/.run/discount-module" to the review-system scripts (reviews/lib/wl.mjs, reviews/lib/run-scoped-tests.mjs), which stay in this repository. The test suite is `node --test` run from the fixture root — hand it to the wrapper as --cmd "node --test" alongside a --filter, and expect the wrapper to record the run without counts, since it parses dotnet and vitest output. Do not push.
evals.expected_output: All four findings driven to a terminal status: PPW-9701 and PPW-9702 fixed in code WITH the regression tests their fix briefs specify, PPW-9703 (the pricing doc) and PPW-9704 (the duplicated ceiling) addressed; resolution-v1.md updated per finding (status + commit + note) with top-level status resolved, fixed_commit and closed; review-v1.md untouched; nothing marked verified; one commit per finding referencing its ID; the round's worklog written through wl.mjs as the work happens — round-start, triage-done, an approach-check dispatched and returned for the trigger-classified PPW-9702, test-run events through the wrapper, a finding event per finding, the round-review pair and, because tests ran red, the test-audit pair — and round-end at hand-back. The fixer runs no renderer, no auditor and no doc gate: those belong to the driver's verification step.

PPW-9703 and PPW-9704 are at a terminal status, and the pricing doc no longer states the unclamped behaviour as the rule
resolution-v1.md top-level status is 'resolved' with fixed_commit and closed set

worklog.jsonl carries the round's mandatory events, all written through wl.mjs: round-start, triage-done, a check-dispatched whose ids include PPW-9702 with its check-returned, a test-run per run, a finding event per finding, the round-review-dispatched/returned pair, the test-audit-dispatched/returned pair, and round-end
no test process was launched outside run-scoped-tests.mjs (every test-run event in the worklog was stamped by the wrapper)
the fixer ran none of render-records.mjs, records-auditor.mjs or doc-gate.mjs, and wrote no index row — the hand-back says the unit's records are pending its verification

records-auditor.mjs --root <run root> discount-module exits 0 afterwards, with the single expected warning 'resolution-v1 resolved, no fix-round line yet — unit records pending' and no error (the hand-back gates R1-R4 pass on the round's own evidence)
